statement: Glioma cells form functional glutamatergic synapses with neurons, and this synaptic input drives tumour progression and invasion.

measurement.endpoint: neuron-to-glioma synaptic transmission and its effect on growth
measurement.effect: functional synapses that promote invasion and growth

replication.note: Reported simultaneously by more than one group in 2019; the companion studies are not cited here.

limitations: mechanistic; no therapy follows from it yet

provenance.method: manual reasoning from the cited sources' abstracts (Crossref/Europe PMC), checked 2026-09-14; no source opened at figure level
